preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='public.auth_event'::regclass AND conname='ck_auth_event_event_type' AND contype='c'

changeSet.comment: Preserve every existing audit event type and admit the MCP client consent and revocation events.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE auth_event DROP CONSTRAINT ck_auth_event_event_type; ALTER TABLE auth_event ADD CONSTRAINT ck_auth_event_event_type CHECK (event_type IN ('USER_VIEW', 'LOGIN', 'PASSKEY_CHANGED', 'PASSKEY_VERIFIED', 'LOGIN_FAILED', 'LOGOUT', 'TOKEN_REFRESH', 'JWT_REVOKED', 'IDENTITY_LINKED', 'IDENTITY_UNLINKED', 'IMPERSONATION_BEGIN', 'IMPERSONATION_END', 'ACCOUNT_DELETED', 'EXPORT_REQUESTED', 'PERSON_DATA_PREVIEWED', 'PERSON_DATA_EXPORTED', 'PERSON_DATA_ERASURE_REQUESTED', 'APP_ROLE_CHANGED', 'ACCOUNT_STATUS_CHANGED', 'RESEARCH_CONSENT_REVOKED', 'WORKSPACE_ELEVATION', 'INSTALLATION_EVENT_REPLAYED', 'GITHUB_INSTALLATION_ADOPTED', 'GITHUB_INSTALLATION_DECLINED', 'WORKSPACE_OWNER_CHANGE', 'WORKSPACE_DELETION', 'PROVIDER_RESOURCE_RELEASE', 'LLM_CONNECTION_CREATED', 'LLM_CONNECTION_UPDATED', 'LLM_CONNECTION_DELETED', 'LLM_MODEL_CREATED', 'LLM_MODEL_UPDATED', 'LLM_MODEL_DELETED', 'LLM_MODEL_PRICE_CHANGED', 'LLM_MODEL_SHARING_CHANGED', 'LLM_SETTINGS_CHANGED', 'LOGIN_PROVIDER_CREATED', 'LOGIN_PROVIDER_UPDATED', 'LOGIN_PROVIDER_DELETED', 'SILENT_MODE_CHANGED', 'PUBLIC_ACTIVITY_CHANGED', 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_DESTINATIONS_CHANGED', 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_CLEANUP_CONFIRMED', 'PRODUCT_FEEDBACK_FILED_BY_ADMIN', 'RESEARCH_DATASET_RELEASED', 'RESEARCH_REMOVAL_RECORDED', 'MCP_CLIENT_APPROVED', 'MCP_CLIENT_REFUSED', 'MCP_CLIENT_REVOKED'));
